SettingsWebhookPatchInput.description: Manually decoded JSON via serde_json::from_slice, independent of Content-Type. Positional array order is [label, enabled, current_secret_ref, previous_secret_ref, previous_secret_until], with trailing elements omittable. No URL update field. Omitted fields retain saved values. Explicit null is rejected for label/enabled/current_secret_ref, but clears previous_secret_ref/previous_secret_until; the rotation fields must end up both set or both cleared in the resulting state. References must be allowlisted env:NAME references, never secret values. A rotation (previous reference plus expiry no later than 24 hours ahead) needs both fields; ending one ends both. Whether a lone non-null rotation field is acceptable depends on the stored state (it must leave the destination with both or neither). When BOTH rotation fields are sent they must be both null or both non-null (the schema enforces this). A LONE rotation field is judged against the stored state and is not refused by the schema: a lone `previous_secret_ref: null` or `previous_secret_until: null` is a 200 no-op on a destination that has no rotation and a 400 on one that has.

SettingsAlertEvent.description: Closed envelope shared by every alert incident variant: identity and lifecycle fields. Every incident has its `fired` email delivery (each producer inserts it in the incident's own transaction, deliveries are immutable), so `email` is never null. `cleared_email` exists only for a cleared incident (alerts.rs resolve: superseded and rule_disabled never enqueue one, and a silently cleared key-expiry reminder has none). The variants (installation rules by kind, built-ins, aged holds, admission ceilings, workspace rules by kind, personal budget, key expiry) pin rule, workspace, connection, kind and the closed per-kind details exactly; this base `details` is the reviewed stored producer-specific JSON.
